findings.reason: The original standalone tiles show only prose path/star descriptions for a classification explicitly by labelled graph isomorphism. A gallery concretely distinguishes exceptional branch positions and the 4/5/m edge labels, materially clarifying clause (1) without serving as its proof.
findings.action: Added two fenced TikZ galleries in a final Remarks section: E6/E7/E8 and F4/H3/H4/I2(m), with the unlabelled-edge convention and explicit parameter range.

correction: Added an explanatory gallery for the exceptional and dihedral standard Coxeter diagrams; all original source bytes remain an unchanged prefix.

diagram_math_checks.objects: E6, E7, E8 labelled simple graphs
diagram_math_checks.check: Each has one branch vertex connected to a vertical leaf and horizontal arms of 2 and respectively 2, 3, 4 vertices. Thus total vertices are 6,7,8, edges 5,6,7, exactly one degree-3 vertex and arm triples (1,2,2), (1,2,3), (1,2,4). All edges are unlabelled, hence label 3.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement (1) E-family bullet; [F3]; def-cg-coxeter-diagram-components-and-finite-type Definition (1)-(2). Actual standalone native PNG has all these vertices and segments.

diagram_math_checks.objects: F4, H3, H4, I2(m) labelled simple paths
diagram_math_checks.check: F4 has 4 vertices/3 edges, label 4 only on its middle edge; H3 has 3 vertices/2 edges, labels 3,5; H4 has 4 vertices/3 edges, labels 3,3,5; I2(m) has 2 vertices/1 edge labelled m, with 3<=m<infinity stated in adjoining prose. Remaining edges have label 3. No arrows, orientations, cycles or morphism relations are asserted.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement (1) final three bullets and [F3]. These exact sequences are used in proof steps 1.4 and 2.1. Actual standalone native PNG shows each complete path with the indicated edge label above its proper edge.

diagram_math_checks.check: The gallery asserts only graph shapes already in Statement (1), with vertices representing elements of S and nonedges denoting matrix entry 2 under the existing convention. It adds no finiteness, positivity or determinant premise; the rigorous proof remains independent of the figures.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement introductory data, [F3], original proof steps 1.3, 2.1, 3.1 and new final Remarks prose.

native_preview.visual_result: Both native diagrams render with all intended vertices/edges and readable labels, without overlap or clipping. Source manifest binds current carrier, native renderer hashes and reference map.
